citations.assessment: The chapter names Reuven ben Atztrobili in a teaching on the evil inclination. Preserve this attestation separately from the persecution narrative.
The Bavli gives the three decrees and their separate initial repeals, identifies the haircut, and names the two emissaries. The next folio explicitly shows the decree being torn up.
The internal target expressly repeats the substitution tradition. The Bavli’s ordination and martyrdom story does not name Reuven.
The two reports in Rav’s name and the alternate baraita are all explicit. The passage leaves the identity of Rav untouched.

Both versions explicitly name the sons as pupils of Rabbi, continue the preceding Angel of Death narrative, and say the sons are taken from the south. Preserve the unstated observer and speaker, and the printed Kilayim numbering alongside the located parallel.
